mission2.rootCause: Dashboard could treat a next_due_date that is not after the performed inspection (including today) as the future inspection, and it did not merge vehicles.next_inspection_date. The previous fix already read next_due_date instead of inspection_date; the remaining gap was stale/same-day next_due values.
mission2.previousFix: 1584cc8a + 2e96b9b1 — card uses next_due_date; latest same-day row by created_at
mission2.whyItStopped: Selecting the latest inspection row with next_due_date not null can still return a row whose next_due_date equals inspection_date (today), so the tile showed today as the future inspection.
mission2.fix: Pick a row whose next due is after the performed date; merge vehicles.next_inspection_date; never display the performed date as next due; parse expiry at noon.
